summary.text: Denise Villalobos is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 34 who took office on January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Denise Villalobos was born in Corpus Christi, Texas.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University-Kingsville and a master's degree from Texas Tech University.
Her career experience includes working in the oil and gas industry.
Villalobos won the November 2024 general election for Texas House District 34, defeating Democrat Solomon Ortiz, 55.4% to 44.6%.
She advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary with no opposition on the ballot.
